law_name: Karnataka Town and Country Planning Act, 1961
summary: All buildings within BBMP limits require approved building plans before construction. Plans must comply with FAR (Floor Area Ratio), setbacks, height restrictions, and land use zoning.
detailed_provisions: Building plans must be submitted to the Layout Approving Authority for approval before commencement of construction.
FAR for residential zones: 1.5 to 3.5 depending on road width and zone.
Minimum setback requirements: Front - 3m to 5m, Rear - 3m, Sides - 1.5m to 3m depending on plot size.
Height restrictions: Maximum G+4 without lift, G+5 and above mandatory lift requirement.
Ground coverage shall not exceed 60% of plot area for residential buildings.
Parking requirements: 1 ECS per 100 sq.m of built-up area for residential; 1 ECS per 50 sq.m for commercial.
penalties: Construction without approved plan attracts penalty up to 10% of project cost and potential demolition order.

summary: All buildings must conform to NBC 2016 structural safety standards including seismic zone compliance, wind load calculations, and fire safety requirements.
detailed_provisions: Bangalore falls in Seismic Zone II - moderate earthquake risk. Basic seismic design mandatory.
Concrete mix minimum M20 for structural elements. Fe415/Fe500 reinforcement steel.
Fire escape requirements: Buildings above 15m height must provide fire escapes.
Fire extinguisher requirements: Minimum 1 per 600 sq.m of floor area.
Staircase width: Minimum 1.0m for residential, 1.5m for commercial. Rise per step max 150mm, going min 300mm.
Ramp requirements: 1:12 gradient for wheelchair accessibility as per GRIHA/ABHA standards.
Structural audit mandatory for buildings older than 30 years.
penalties: Non-compliance can result in occupancy certificate refusal, fines up to ₹5 lakh, and demolition orders.

section: Category A and Category B Projects
authority: Karnataka State Pollution Control Board (KSPCB) / MoEFCC
summary: Projects above specified thresholds require environmental clearance from SEAC/NEAC. Construction projects in critically polluted areas need additional consent.
detailed_provisions: Township and area development projects > 150 hectares require Category A clearance from NEAC.
Construction projects > 20,000 sq.m in CRZ require EIA.
Environmental Impact Assessment report mandatory for projects in Critically Polluted Areas.
Public hearing mandatory for Category A projects.
Consent to Establish (CTE) required before construction commencement.
Consent to Operate (CTO) required before occupancy.
Annual Environmental Statement filing mandatory.
penalties: Construction without environmental clearance attracts fine up to ₹10 crore and imprisonment up to 3 years under EIA Notification.

law_name: Karnataka Water Resources Regulatory Authority Act, 2011
authority: Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB)
summary: All new construction must obtain water connection approval from BWSSB. Rainwater harvesting mandatory for buildings > 300 sq.m built-up area.
detailed_provisions: Rainwater harvesting mandatory for all buildings with built-up area exceeding 300 sq.m.
Minimum rainwater harvesting capacity: 20 liters per sq.m of roof area.
Underground water extraction requires CGWB/BWSSB permission via NOC.
Sewage connection mandatory for all habitable buildings.
Water audit mandatory for commercial buildings > 5000 sq.m.
Grey water recycling system recommended for buildings > 10,000 sq.m.
STP (Sewage Treatment Plant) mandatory for buildings with > 20 dwelling units.
penalties: Non-compliance with rainwater harvesting: Fine up to ₹5 lakh and disconnection of water supply.

law_name: Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981
summary: Construction activities must comply with air quality norms. Dust control measures mandatory at all construction sites. Industrial emissions must meet prescribed standards.
detailed_provisions: Construction sites must implement dust control: water sprinkling, anti-smog guns, covered debris transport.
Particulate matter limits: PM10 < 100 μg/m³ (24-hr), PM2.5 < 60 μg/m³ (24-hr) in residential areas.
Construction vehicles must meet BS-VI emission standards.
No burning of construction debris allowed. Dry waste management mandatory.
Ambient air quality monitoring station required for projects > 10 acres.
Stack height for industrial emissions: Minimum 30m for new industries.
CETP (Common Effluent Treatment Plant) connectivity required in industrial areas.
penalties: Violation of emission norms: ₹1,000 to ₹10,000 per day; continued violation: imprisonment up to 3 months.

summary: Building permission depends on road width. Access to public road must meet BBMP standards. Road widening encroachment rules apply.
detailed_provisions: Building permission granted only on roads with minimum 9m width (residential) and 12m (commercial).
Buildings on roads < 9m width: Permission only for single floor/ground floor.
Road setback: Buildings must leave 3m from center of road for roads < 12m, 4.5m for 12-18m roads.
Compound wall height: Maximum 1.2m on road-facing side. Transparent fencing encouraged.
Road connectivity: Minimum 2 access points for plots > 5 acres.
Pedestrian footpath: 1.5m minimum width alongside all commercial developments.
Traffic impact assessment required for buildings generating > 500 PCUs.
penalties: Encroachment on road property: Demolition + fine up to ₹25,000/day for continued encroachment.

summary: Regulations for affordable housing, EWS/LIG housing mandates, and housing board allocations in Bangalore.
detailed_provisions: 15% of total units in all new housing projects must be EWS (Economically Weaker Section) category.
10% of total units for LIG (Low Income Group) category.
EWS unit size: Minimum 21 sq.m carpet area. LIG: Minimum 30 sq.m carpet area.
BHK (Bangalore Navodaya Housing) schemes for affordable housing allocation.
Housing subsidy under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) applicable.
PIDB (Promoters and Individual Developers) must register under RERA.
Maintenance of common areas: RWA formation mandatory for > 8 units.
penalties: Non-compliance with affordable housing mandates: Penalty up to 5% of project cost under RERA.

summary: Industrial construction must comply with KIADB zoning, industrial park regulations, and SEZ guidelines. Separation distances from residential areas mandatory.
detailed_provisions: Minimum 500m buffer zone between industrial and residential areas for Category A industries.
Minimum 200m buffer for Category B industries.
Industrial buildings must have minimum 4m floor-to-floor height.
Loading dock requirements: Minimum 1 per 500 sq.m of industrial floor area.
Hazardous material storage: Must comply with PESO (Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organisation) norms.
Fire safety: Industrial buildings > 500 sq.m require fire NOC from Karnataka Fire Services.
Industrial effluent must be treated before discharge as per KSPCB standards.
penalties: Operating in wrong zone: Closure order + fine up to ₹1 lakh/day.

summary: All construction in Chennai requires GCC approval. Specific rules for coastal zone, CRZ compliance, and flood-prone area construction.
detailed_provisions: Building plans must be approved by GCC through online PRISM system.
FAR for residential: 1.75 to 3.00 based on plot size and road width.
Minimum setback: Front - 3m to 6m, Rear - 2m to 4m, Sides - 1.5m to 3m.
Maximum building height in CRZ-I: Ground floor only. CRZ-II: As per local body rules.
Stilt parking mandatory for buildings > 4 floors or built-up area > 500 sq.m.
Compact car parking: Minimum 2.5m x 5m. Two-wheeler: 1.5m x 2.5m.
Lift requirement mandatory for buildings > 15m height or > 4 floors.
Termite treatment mandatory for all buildings in Chennai due to coastal climate.
penalties: Unauthorized construction: Demolition + penalty up to 25% of construction cost.

summary: Chennai being a coastal city has extensive CRZ regulations. Construction is strictly regulated in CRZ zones along the Marina Beach and coastline.
detailed_provisions: CRZ-I (Ecologically Sensitive): No construction permitted. Includes mangroves, salt marshes, turtle nesting.
CRZ-II (Built-up Area): Permitted with conditions. Existing structures can be reconstructed within existing footprint.
CRZ-III (Rural): No new construction within 200m of High Tide Line (HTL). Special exceptions for LIDAR.
CRZ-IV (Water): No construction in water body area.
CRZ distance from HTL: 50m (CRZ-I A), 100m (CRZ-I B), 200m (CRZ-III rural), 500m (Municipal).
Flood risk assessment mandatory for construction within 1km of Adyar/Cooum river.
CRZ clearance from SEAC Tamil Nadu mandatory for projects in CRZ zones.
Chennai flood buffer zone: Construction restricted in low-lying areas per ADCDM guidelines.
penalties: CRZ violation: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine up to ₹10 lakh. Structure demolished at owner's cost.

law_name: Tamil Nadu Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, 1970
authority: Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (CMWSSB)
summary: Mandatory water connection from CMWSSB. Rainwater harvesting strictly enforced in Chennai due to water scarcity. STP requirement for large buildings.
detailed_provisions: Rainwater harvesting mandatory for ALL buildings regardless of size (Tamil Nadu is pioneer state).
Minimum RWH capacity: 2.5 liters per sq.m of rooftop area.
Borewell registration mandatory with CGWB. New borewell restriction in Chennai city.
STP mandatory for all new residential projects > 20 units.
Grey water reuse mandatory for commercial buildings > 5000 sq.m built-up area.
Chennai Smart Water Meter: Mandatory for new connections in GCC limits.
Pipeline setback: Minimum 1m from property boundary for water/sewer lines.
Coastal aquifer protection: No construction that may contaminate coastal groundwater.
penalties: Non-compliance with RWH: Fine ₹5,000 + water connection disconnection. Non-registration of borewell: ₹10,000 fine.

law_name: Tamil Nadu Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Rules, 1982
summary: Strict air quality norms in Chennai due to vehicular and industrial pollution. Construction sites must follow dust and emission norms.
detailed_provisions: Construction site dust control: Anti-smog guns mandatory for sites > 10,000 sq.m.
PM2.5 limits: 40 μg/m³ (annual), 60 μg/m³ (24-hr) in residential areas.
PM10 limits: 60 μg/m³ (annual), 100 μg/m³ (24-hr) in residential areas.
SO2 limits: 50 μg/m³ (annual), 80 μg/m³ (24-hr).
NOx limits: 40 μg/m³ (annual), 80 μg/m³ (24-hr).
Construction vehicles must meet emission norms. Dust screens mandatory on construction boundaries.
Ambient air quality monitoring for industrial projects > 10 acres.
VOC limits for paint and coating applications in construction.
penalties: Exceeding emission norms: ₹10,000 per violation. Chronic violators: Plant closure.

authority: Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) / Delhi Development Authority (DDA)
summary: Comprehensive building bye-laws for Delhi covering all construction types. Height restrictions near airports (IGI) and defense establishments.
detailed_provisions: Building plans approved via MCD online portal (e-Abhilekh).
FAR: Residential - 1.5 to 3.5 (varies by zone). Commercial - 3.5 maximum.
Ground coverage: 50% to 75% depending on plot size. Larger plots have lower coverage.
Height restrictions: No building > 150m in Delhi. Height-to-road-width ratio applies.
Airport height restriction: Maximum 45m in approach zone of IGI airport. Civil aviation NOC mandatory.
Setback: Front - 3m to 6m, Rear - 3m minimum, Sides - 2m to 3m.
Stilt parking mandatory for all buildings > 4 floors.
EDC (External Development Charges) and IDC (Internal Development Charges) payable.
Compounding fee for deviations: 2% of construction cost per floor deviation.
penalties: Unauthorized construction: Demolition by MCD enforcement. Fine ₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh depending on scale.

summary: Fire safety compliance mandatory for all buildings in Delhi. High-rise and high-occupancy buildings have stringent fire safety requirements.
detailed_provisions: Fire NOC mandatory for all buildings > 15m height or > 500 sq.m ground coverage.
High-rise buildings (> 15m): Wet riser system, sprinklers, smoke detectors on all floors.
Assembly buildings (> 100 persons): Maximum 2 exits per floor, fire escape on each floor.
Fire escape width: Minimum 1.0m. Maximum travel distance to exit: 22.5m (sprinklered), 18m (non-sprinklered).
Fire lift: Mandatory for buildings > 30m height. Capacity: 6-8 persons.
Refuge area: Every 7th floor in buildings > 24m height. Minimum 15 sq.m per refuge area.
Staircase pressurization mandatory for buildings > 30m.
Annual fire safety audit mandatory for high-rise buildings.
penalties: Non-compliance: Construction stoppage order + fine up to ₹5 lakh. Repeated violation: Demolition.

law_name: Environmental Pollution (Control and Authority) Act, 1986 / NGT Order
authority: EPCA / Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) / DPCC
summary: Delhi has the strictest pollution control measures in India. Construction banned during GRAP Stage 3-4. BS-VI emission norms strictly enforced.
detailed_provisions: GRAP (Graded Response Action Plan): Construction banned during Stage 3 (Severe) and Stage 4 (Severe+).
Construction activity curbs: Even during non-ban periods, anti-smog guns and dust screens mandatory.
PM2.5 limits: 40 μg/m³ (annual), 60 μg/m³ (24-hr) in residential areas.
PM10 limits: 60 μg/m³ (annual), 100 μg/m³ (24-hr).
Diesel generator sets banned in non-emergency situations in NCR.
Construction waste management: C&D Waste Management Rules 2016 apply.
NGT orders: No construction activity within 100m of rivers/canals in Delhi.
Air quality index display boards mandatory at construction sites.
penalties: GRAP violation: ₹1-10 lakh per violation. C&D waste violation: ₹5,000-25,000.

summary: Water connection and drainage rules for Delhi. Water harvesting mandatory. Groundwater regulation strict.
detailed_provisions: Rainwater harvesting mandatory for all buildings > 50 sq.m plot area in Delhi.
Underground water extraction: Borewell registration with CGWB mandatory.
STP mandatory for buildings > 20 dwelling units or > 5000 sq.m built-up area.
Sewerage connection from DJB mandatory before occupancy certificate.
Water meter installation mandatory for all new connections.
Pipeline setback: 1m from property line for water, 1.5m for sewer.
Zero liquid discharge (ZLD) system required for industrial construction.
Storm water drainage: Separate system required for large developments (> 5 acres).
penalties: Unauthorized water connection: ₹10,000 fine + disconnection. Non-RWH: ₹5,000 fine + notice.

summary: Comprehensive road and infrastructure standards including road widths, footpaths, cycling tracks, and public transport integration.
detailed_provisions: Arterial roads: Minimum 30m width. Sub-arterial: 18-30m. Collector: 12-18m. Local: 9-12m.
Building permission: Only on roads >= 9m width for G+1. Roads >= 12m for G+4.
Footpath: Minimum 2m width on main roads, 1.5m on other roads.
Cycle track: Mandatory for roads > 20m width in new developments.
Bus bay: Mandatory for commercial buildings generating > 200 PCUs.
Traffic impact assessment for buildings generating > 500 PCUs.
Multi-level parking: Mandatory for commercial buildings > 2000 sq.m.
Metro buffer: No construction within 3m of metro line boundary.
Utilities duct: Underground utility corridor in roads > 18m width.
penalties: Road encroachment: Immediate removal + fine up to ₹1 lakh/day.

summary: Delhi's industrial policy focuses on relocation of non-conforming industries. New industrial construction restricted in most zones.
detailed_provisions: Non-conforming industries must relocate to designated NCR regions by 2025 deadline.
Industrial construction only permitted in designated industrial estates.
Minimum land area for new industry: 500 sq.m within Delhi.
Heavy industry: Prohibited within Delhi. Only light/service industry permitted.
Buffer zone: 100m from residential for service industry, 500m for manufacturing.
Green belt: 33% of industrial plot must be green cover.
Hazardous material storage: PESO approval mandatory. Distance from residential: 500m minimum.
Environmental clearance for all new industrial projects > 20,000 sq.m.
penalties: Non-conforming industry: Demolition order + compensation. Wrong zone: Closure + ₹50,000 fine.

law_name: Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning (MRTP) Act, 1966 & DC Rules 2016
summary: Mumbai has complex building regulations including Transferable Development Rights (TDR), FSI (Floor Space Index), and CRZ restrictions.
detailed_provisions: FSI (Floor Space Index): Residential - 1.0 to 3.0 depending on zone. TDR can increase effective FSI.
TDR (Transferable Development Rights): Available for road widening, open space reservations.
MTDC (Minimum Distance to Chowk): Buildings must maintain distance from intersections.
Setback: Front - 3m to 6m, Rear - 3m minimum, Sides - 1.5m to 3m.
Height restriction: Airport authority NOC needed above 60m in south Mumbai.
BMC online building permission system (e-BPS) mandatory.
Premium FSI: Available at 50% to 100% of base FSI at premium charges.
Podium restrictions: Maximum 2 floors podium for buildings > 40m.
Stilt parking mandatory. 2 car parks per 3 apartments for 2BHK+.
penalties: Unauthorized construction: Demolition + prosecution under Section 13 of MRTP Act. Fine up to ₹25 lakh.

law_name: Maharashtra Slum Areas (Improvement, Clearance and Redevelopment) Act, 1971
summary: Comprehensive slum rehabilitation regulations for Mumbai. SRA scheme for redevelopment of slum areas with incentive FSI.
detailed_provisions: SRA Scheme: Developer gets incentive FSI for rehousing slum dwellers in-situ.
Eligible slum dweller: Must prove occupation before January 1, 2000.
Minimum carpet area: 26.9 sq.m (225 sq.ft) per slum family in new construction.
Incentive FSI: 2.5 to 4.0 for slum rehabilitation projects.
50% eligible members must consent for SRA scheme activation.
Project must be completed within 3 years of approval.
Rent reimbursement during construction: ₹5,000/month per family.
Transparency: SRA must display project status on website.
penalties: Delayed project: Interest penalty + potential project takeover by SRA. Fraud: Criminal prosecution.

law_name: CRZ Notification 2019 & Maharashtra Pollution Control Board Rules
summary: Mumbai has extensive CRZ zones including mangrove areas. Construction strictly regulated along the coastline and creek areas.
detailed_provisions: CRZ-I: No construction in mangrove areas, mudflats, and ecologically sensitive zones.
CRZ-II: Construction permitted in existing built-up areas with conditions.
CRZ-III: No construction within 200m of HTL in non-municipal areas, 500m in municipal.
CRZ-IV: No construction in water body.
Mangrove protection: 50m buffer zone around all mangrove patches. BMC Tree Authority NOC.
Thane Creek flamingo sanctuary: 1km buffer. No construction within buffer.
Flood zone: Construction restricted in low-lying areas per MCGM flood line.
EIA mandatory for all projects within CRZ zone.
CRZ clearance from SEAC Maharashtra for all CRZ projects.
penalties: CRZ violation: Imprisonment up to 3 years + fine up to ₹10 lakh + demolition.

law_name: Maharashtra Water Supply and Sewerage Act, 1976
summary: Water connection rules, rainwater harvesting, and sewage treatment requirements for Mumbai construction.
detailed_provisions: Rainwater harvesting mandatory for buildings > 300 sq.m plot area.
Water connection approval from BMC Hydraulic before construction.
STP mandatory for buildings > 20 dwelling units or built-up area > 10,000 sq.m.
Water meter: Mandatory for all new connections. Bulk metering for societies.
Grey water recycling: Mandatory for commercial buildings > 5000 sq.m.
Storm water drainage: Mandatory for developments > 1 acre.
Flood protection: Raised plinth level minimum 450mm above road level.
Mithi River buffer: No construction within 50m of Mithi River.
penalties: Unauthorized water connection: Fine ₹10,000 + connection removal. Non-RWH: ₹5,000 + notice.

summary: Road and infrastructure standards for Mumbai including metro corridor restrictions, coastal road, and bridge restrictions.
detailed_provisions: Building permission: Roads >= 9m for G+1. Roads >= 12m for G+3 and above.
Highway setback: Minimum 15m from national/state highway boundary.
Metro corridor: No construction within 3m of metro line. Height restriction near metro stations.
Coastal Road: 100m buffer zone from Coastal Road alignment.
Flyover bridge: Height clearance minimum 5.5m under flyovers.
Traffic impact assessment mandatory for buildings generating > 500 PCUs.
BSMC (Brihanmumbai Storm Water Disposal) compliance mandatory.
Footpath: Minimum 2m on arterial roads, 1.5m on others.
penalties: Encroachment: Demolition + fine ₹1 lakh/day. Metro buffer violation: Construction stoppage.

summary: Industrial construction rules for Mumbai and MMR region including SEZ regulations and MIDC area standards.
detailed_provisions: MIDC areas: Construction only as per MIDC land use plan. Change of land use requires government approval.
SEZ construction: Must comply with SEZ Act and MIDA (Maharashtra Industrial Development Act).
Buffer zone: 500m between industrial and residential areas.
Hazardous industry: Must be 1km from residential. PESO approval mandatory.
Fire NOC: Mandatory for all industrial buildings from Maharashtra Fire Services.
Industrial shed: Minimum 4.5m clear height for single story, 4m for multi-story.
Loading/unloading: Dock facilities mandatory for factories > 1000 sq.m.
CETP: Required in industrial estates with > 10 units.
penalties: Wrong zone usage: Closure order + ₹1 lakh fine. Fire violation: Stop work + ₹5 lakh fine.

summary: Building regulations for Hyderabad covering plan approval, FAR, setbacks, and height restrictions. DCP (Detailed City Plan) zones apply.
detailed_provisions: Building plans approved through GHMC online portal (Building Permission System - BPS).
FAR: Residential - 1.5 to 3.5. Commercial - 3.0 to 5.0 depending on zone and road width.
Ground coverage: 50% to 75% based on plot area.
Setback: Front - 3m to 6m, Rear - 3m, Sides - 2m to 3m.
Height restriction: G+4 minimum without lift. G+5 and above mandatory lift.
Airport height restriction: 45m near Shamshabad (RGI Airport). AAI NOC required.
Parking: 1 ECS per 100 sq.m (residential), 1 ECS per 50 sq.m (commercial).
CDMA (City Development Master Area) compliance for layout approval.
Plot regularization: LBOP (Layout Building Optimization Plan) for unauthorized layouts.
penalties: Unapproved plan: Demolition + fine up to 10% of construction cost. Height violation: Demolition.

summary: Heritage zone construction restrictions. Lake and water body protection regulations in Hyderabad.
detailed_provisions: Heritage zone: No construction within 100m of listed heritage structures.
Buffer zone: 50m around heritage monuments. Height restriction: Ground floor only.
Lake protection: 30m buffer around all lakes. No construction within lake bed.
Flood flow zone: No construction in identified flood flow paths from Musi River.
Abdullah Husain Sagar, Hussain Sagar: 100m buffer. Height restriction within 500m.
Nakki Cheruvu and other water bodies: 30m no-construction zone.
Heritage Impact Assessment mandatory for projects near heritage sites.
GHMC Heritage Cell clearance for construction within heritage buffer zones.
penalties: Heritage violation: Demolition + fine up to ₹5 lakh. Lake encroachment: Demolition + criminal case.

law_name: Telangana State Pollution Control Board Rules
summary: Environmental regulations for construction in Hyderabad. Air and water quality norms.
detailed_provisions: CTE (Consent to Establish) mandatory from TSPCB before construction for commercial/industrial.
CTO (Consent to Operate) required before occupancy.
Air quality: PM2.5 < 40 μg/m³ (annual), PM10 < 60 μg/m³ (annual).
Construction dust: Water sprinkling mandatory. Dust screen for sites > 5000 sq.m.
Noise norms: Daytime < 75 dB(A), Nighttime < 70 dB(A) at construction sites.
Construction waste: Segregation mandatory. Disposal at authorized C&D waste facility.
Environmental monitoring: Quarterly air quality reports for projects > 20,000 sq.m.
Green building certification (IGBC/GRIHA) incentivized through additional FAR.
penalties: CTE violation: ₹10,000 to ₹1 lakh. Noise violation: ₹5,000 per incident.

law_name: Telangana Water Supply and Sewerage Board Act, 1998
authority: HMWSSB (Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply & Sewerage Board)
summary: Water connection and conservation rules. Rainwater harvesting mandatory. STP requirements.
detailed_provisions: Rainwater harvesting mandatory for buildings > 300 sq.m built-up area.
Minimum RWH capacity: 20 liters per sq.m of roof area.
Borewell registration mandatory with CGWB. New borewell restrictions in GHMC limits.
STP mandatory for buildings > 20 dwelling units or > 10,000 sq.m built-up area.
Grey water recycling mandatory for commercial buildings > 5000 sq.m.
Water meter mandatory for all new connections.
Pipeline setback: 1m from property boundary for water, 1.5m for sewer.
Tanker water supply regulation: Registration with HMWSSB mandatory.
penalties: Non-RWH: ₹10,000 fine + water connection denial. Unauthorized borewell: ₹25,000 fine + sealing.

summary: Road and infrastructure standards for Hyderabad under HMDA jurisdiction.
detailed_provisions: HMDA layout: Roads must be minimum 9m width (LIG), 12m (MIG/HIG).
Building permission: Only on roads >= 9m width.
Ring Road buffer: No construction within 30m of ORR boundary.
Metro corridor: No construction within 3m of metro line boundary.
Flyover clearance: 5.5m minimum height under all flyovers.
Traffic impact assessment for buildings generating > 300 PCUs.
Parking: 1 ECS per 100 sq.m (residential), 1 ECS per 50 sq.m (commercial).
HMDA conversion charges applicable for land use change.
Road widening reservation: Building must leave space as per HMDA road plan.
penalties: Encroachment: Demolition + fine ₹25,000/day. Metro buffer: Construction stoppage.

summary: Industrial construction regulations in Hyderabad. TS-iPASS for fast-track industrial approvals.
detailed_provisions: TS-iPASS: Single-window clearance for all industrial projects within 15 days.
Industrial park construction: TSIIC land allotment mandatory for government industrial parks.
Buffer zone: 500m between industrial and residential for heavy industry, 200m for light.
Hazardous material: PESO approval + 1km distance from residential.
Fire NOC: Mandatory for industrial buildings > 500 sq.m.
Industrial building: Minimum 4m clear height. Loading dock mandatory.
Green belt: 33% of industrial plot area.
CETP required in industrial clusters with > 10 units.
Pharma industry: Additional TSPCB compliance for API manufacturing.
penalties: Wrong zone: Closure + ₹1 lakh fine. Fire violation: Stop work + ₹5 lakh fine.

summary: All real estate projects > 500 sq.m or > 8 apartments must be registered under RERA. Mandatory disclosure, timeline adherence, and buyer protection.
detailed_provisions: Project registration mandatory for projects > 500 sq.m or > 8 apartments.
Quarterly progress disclosure on RERA website mandatory.
Escrow account: 70% of project receipts in separate escrow for construction.
Timeline adherence: Project must be completed as per registered timeline.
Defect liability: Developer liable for structural defects for 5 years after possession.
Carpet area disclosure: Mandatory. No super built-up area misrepresentation.
Allottee can withdraw and get full refund with interest if delay > 6 months.
Adjudicating officer for dispute resolution. Appellate Tribunal for appeals.
Agent registration mandatory for all real estate agents.
penalties: Non-registration: 10% of project cost. Delay: Interest + compensation. Fraud: Imprisonment up to 3 years.

summary: Comprehensive building code covering planning, structural design, fire safety, electrical, plumbing, and accessibility.
detailed_provisions: Part 1: Administration - Building permit process and inspections.
Part 2: Layout - Site planning, zoning, and open spaces.
Part 3: Building and Structural Materials - Standards for cement, steel, concrete.
Part 4: Structural Design - Load calculations, seismic design, foundation design.
Part 5: Fire Safety - Detection, alarm, suppression systems. Means of escape.
Part 6: Building Services - Electrical, plumbing, HVAC, elevator installations.
Part 7: Construction Safety - Worker safety during construction phase.
Part 8: Building and Area Management - Maintenance, repair, demolition.
Part 9: Approvals - Plan approval, inspection, and certification.
Part 10: Plumbing - Water supply, drainage, gas supply systems.
Part 11: Accessibility - Universal design, barrier-free access for disabled.
penalties: NBC non-compliance: Occupancy certificate refusal. Structural non-compliance: Demolition.

law_name: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
summary: Mandatory accessibility requirements for all public buildings and new construction. Barrier-free design required.
detailed_provisions: All new public buildings must be fully accessible (wheelchair, visually impaired).
Ramp: 1:12 gradient minimum. Handrails on both sides. Landing every 9m.
Accessible toilet: Minimum 1 per floor in public buildings.
Braille signage: Mandatory in all public buildings.
Elevator: Accessible elevator in buildings > 15m height. Braille buttons.
Parking: Minimum 2% accessible parking spaces.
Counter height: Maximum 75cm for service counters.
Auditory signals: Audio announcements in lifts for visually impaired.
Tactile floor indicators: Mandatory in public buildings at key locations.
penalties: Non-compliance: Fine up to ₹5 lakh. Repeat offense: Imprisonment up to 6 months.

law_number: Act No. 36 of 2003 / Act No. 22 of 2001
summary: Energy efficiency norms for building construction. ECBC compliance mandatory for large buildings.
detailed_provisions: ECBC (Energy Conservation Building Code): Mandatory for commercial buildings > 500 sq.m.
ECBC ratings: Basic, Silver, Gold, Platinum based on energy performance.
HVAC efficiency: Minimum EER 2.8 for air-cooled, 4.0 for water-cooled chillers.
Lighting: LED mandatory. Max 5W/sq.m for office, 10W/sq.m for retail.
Solar water heating: Mandatory for buildings > 27 units or > 100 persons.
Solar rooftop: Mandatory for government buildings. Recommended for all.
DG set: Acoustic enclosure mandatory. Emission compliance as per CPCB norms.
Electrical inspection: Mandatory before energization. CEIG approval.
penalties: ECBC non-compliance: OCC certificate denial. Energy code violation: Fine up to ₹10 lakh.

law_name: Building and Other Construction Workers Act, 1996
summary: Worker safety during construction. Registration of building workers. Safety norms at construction sites.
detailed_provisions: Construction site registration with local authority mandatory.
Safety officer mandatory for sites with > 20 workers.
PPE (Personal Protective Equipment): Hard hats, safety shoes, goggles mandatory for all workers.
Scaffolding: Must comply with IS 3696 standards. Daily inspection.
Excavation safety: Shoring/trenching for excavation > 1.5m depth.
Crane operation: Certified operator mandatory. Annual inspection.
Fire extinguisher: Minimum 1 per 200 sq.m at construction site.
First aid: Mandatory first aid kit and trained person at site.
Building welfare cess: 1-2% of construction cost for worker welfare.
penalties: Safety violation: Fine ₹25,000 to ₹1 lakh. Serious incident: Imprisonment up to 2 years.

law_name: Construction and Demolition Waste Management Rules, 2016
summary: Mandatory C&D waste management. Waste segregation, recycling, and disposal rules for all construction and demolition activities.
detailed_provisions: Waste segregation at source: Concrete, bricks, wood, metal, plastic, hazardous.
Construction waste management plan mandatory for projects > 500 sq.m.
Minimum 50% recycling of C&D waste mandated for government projects.
C&D waste processing facility: Required in all cities with population > 1 million.
Transportation: Only in covered vehicles. Disposal at authorized facilities.
Debris management: Cannot be dumped in open areas, water bodies, or roads.
Demolition waste: Before demolition, hazardous materials (asbestos, lead paint) must be removed.
Extended producer responsibility for packaging waste at construction sites.
penalties: Non-compliance: ₹5,000 to ₹50,000. Dumping in water body: Up to ₹1 lakh + remediation cost.

summary: Noise level standards for construction activities. Time restrictions and zone-based limits.
detailed_provisions: Residential area: Day 55 dB(A), Night 45 dB(A). Silence zone: Day 50 dB(A), Night 40 dB(A).
Commercial area: Day 65 dB(A), Night 55 dB(A). Industrial area: Day 75 dB(A), Night 70 dB(A).
Construction noise: Allowed 6 AM to 10 PM only. No construction on national holidays.
Silence zones: No construction within 100m of hospitals, schools, courts.
Construction equipment: Must have valid noise certificate. Anti-vibration pads mandatory.
Night construction: Requires special permission from SPCB. Emergency exceptions apply.
Sound level monitoring: Mandatory at boundary for construction sites > 10,000 sq.m.
penalties: Noise violation: ₹1,000 to ₹10,000 per incident. Repeat violation: Up to ₹25,000.

summary: Protection of wetlands from construction activities. No construction in identified wetlands.
detailed_provisions: No construction permitted in wetland areas identified by State Wetland Authority.
Buffer zone: 50m around all identified wetlands. No construction within buffer.
Encroachment of wetlands: Must be removed. Restoration required at violator's cost.
Wetland Regulatory Authority to identify and notify wetlands in each district.
Construction in wetland catchment: EIA mandatory.
Lake/wetland filling: Strictly prohibited. Penalty under Environmental Protection Act.
Compensatory afforestation: 2:1 ratio if any wetland area is disturbed.
Monitoring: Quarterly satellite monitoring of wetland areas.
penalties: Wetland encroachment: Demolition + fine up to ₹5 crore. Filling: Environmental compensation + jail.

summary: Green building certification standards. Various cities offer FAR incentives for green-certified buildings.
detailed_provisions: IGBC Green Homes: Platinum (82+), Gold (68-81), Silver (55-67) rating points.
GRIHA: 4-star (100+), 3-star (80-99), 2-star (60-79) points.
Solar panels: 1-2% of power from solar for Green Building certification.
Water efficiency: 30% reduction in water use vs. baseline for Gold rating.
Material efficiency: Use of fly ash, GGBS in concrete. Recycled steel.
Bamboo and recycled material credits.
FCR (Fly Ash Brick) or AAC blocks: Preferred over red clay bricks.
Energy efficiency: 40% improvement over baseline for Platinum IGBC.
Bangalore: Additional 10% FAR for IGBC Platinum certified buildings.
Chennai: Additional 5% FAR for GRIHA 3-star and above.
penalties: No penalty for non-adoption. Loss of FAR incentive for certified buildings that don't maintain standards.

law_name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) - Housing for All
authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
summary: Affordable housing scheme providing subsidies and incentives for EWS/LIG/MIG housing construction.
detailed_provisions: Interest subsidy: 6.5% for EWS/LIG (up to ₹2.67 lakh benefit).
Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS): EWS (₹3 lakh), LIG (₹6 lakh), MIG-I (₹9 lakh), MIG-II (₹12 lakh) loan.
EWS: Annual income ≤ ₹3 lakh. LIG: ₹3-6 lakh. MIG-I: ₹6-12 lakh. MIG-II: ₹12-18 lakh.
Beneficiary: Family with no pucca house. One unit per family.
Construction technology: Use of innovative technologies (prefab, 3D printing, etc.) incentivized.
In-situ slum redevelopment: Slum dwellers get free houses in same area.
Affordable Rental Housing Complexes (ARHC): For urban migrants.
Street vendors: Priority in housing allocation under PMAY.
penalties: Beneficiary fraud: Recovery of subsidy + legal action. Non-completion: Subsidy recovery.

law_name: NBC Part 10 - Plumbing, Drainage and Sanitation
summary: Comprehensive plumbing, drainage, and sanitation standards for all buildings.
detailed_provisions: Water supply: Minimum 135 liters per capita per day (lpcd) for residential.
Flushing: 50 lpcd. Kitchen: 30 lpcd. Bathing: 55 lpcd.
Overhead tank: Minimum 30% reserve over daily requirement.
Underground tank: Minimum 50% of daily requirement.
Pipe sizing: Based on fixture units calculation per NBC Part 10.
Sewer line: Minimum 150mm diameter. Gradient: 1:60 to 1:120.
Manhole: Maximum 30m spacing. Inspection chamber at every change of direction.
Gas pipeline: Separate internal piping system. Copper/SS pipes for gas.
Fire fighting: Separate plumbing system as per NBC Part 5.
penalties: Plumbing non-compliance: Plan rejection. Post-construction: Modification order.

summary: Electrical installation standards. CEIG approval mandatory. Earthing and safety requirements.
detailed_provisions: Electrical plan approval: Mandatory from DISCOM before construction.
Earthing: Minimum 2 earth pits per building. GI plate/pipe earthing.
MCB/MCCB: Mandatory distribution boards for all buildings.
Wiring: FR-LSH (Fire Retardant Low Smoke Halogen) cables for high-rise.
DG room: Separate room with ventilation, fuel storage, and exhaust.
EV charging: Provision in 20% parking for new residential > 10 units.
Solar: 10% of area for solar panels on roof for commercial buildings.
UPS room: Separate room for IT/data-intensive commercial buildings.
Lightning arrestor: Mandatory for buildings > 15m height.
penalties: Unauthorized connection: Fine + disconnection. Safety violation: Stop work + fine ₹50,000.

law_name: National Building Code Part 6 & Lift Act (State specific)
authority: Chief Inspector of Lifts (State) / Local Authority
summary: Elevator installation standards. Mandatory for buildings above certain heights. Safety and maintenance requirements.
detailed_provisions: Lift mandatory: Buildings > 15m height or > 4 floors.
Lift capacity: Minimum 630 kg (8 persons) for residential. 1000 kg for commercial.
Lift pit: Minimum 1.5m depth. Machine room: Minimum 2.5m height.
Emergency features: Alarm, telephone, emergency lighting, door interlock.
Fire fighting lift: Mandatory for buildings > 30m. 1000 kg capacity minimum.
Annual inspection: Mandatory by government-approved agency.
Maintenance contract: Mandatory with licensed lift company.
Stretcher lift: Required in hospital/medical buildings. Minimum 2100mm x 1100mm car.
Energy efficiency: Regenerative drive or VFD mandatory for new installations.
penalties: No lift when required: Occupancy certificate refused. Safety violation: Lift sealed + fine ₹1 lakh.

law_name: IS Code 4326, IS 1893, IS 16700 & State Structural Audit Rules
authority: IIT/NIT Certified Structural Engineers / Local Authority
summary: Structural audit and certification requirements. Seismic compliance. Structural integrity certification.
detailed_provisions: Structural audit mandatory for buildings > 30 years old in all cities.
Seismic design: IS 1893 Part 1 - India divided into 5 seismic zones.
Zone II: Bangalore, Hyderabad. Zone IV: Delhi, Mumbai. Zone V: Northeast.
Structural stability certificate: Required before occupancy certificate.
Load testing: For pre-stressed/concrete elements, load test as per IS 4326.
Soil investigation: Mandatory for all buildings > 3 floors. Report from approved lab.
Foundation design: Based on soil investigation report. Rock/pile foundation for deep loads.
Structural engineer registration: Must be IStructE/NICEE certified for high-rise.
Peer review: Mandatory for buildings > 60m height or > 15 floors.
penalties: No structural certificate: Occupancy denied. False certificate: Engineer license cancellation + prosecution.

law_name: Karnataka Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2017
summary: State-specific RERA implementation for Bangalore. Registration, compliance, and buyer protection.
detailed_provisions: Project registration: Mandatory for projects > 500 sq.m or > 8 apartments.
Registration fee: 0.1% of project cost. Renewal fee: 0.05% annually.
Escrow account: 70% of receipts in separate account.
Quarterly update on website: Construction progress, financial status.
Agent registration: ₹25,000 fee. Validity: 5 years.
Complaint resolution: Within 60 days by RERA authority.
Carpet area: Only carpet area can be marketed. Super built-up not allowed.
Compensation: Up to 12% interest on delayed payments from buyer.
Section 14: Cannot transfer majority rights without buyer consent.
penalties: Developer: 5% of project cost for non-registration. Agent: ₹10,000/day for non-registration.

summary: CMDA-specific building regulations for Chennai Metropolitan Area. Layout and building plan approvals.
detailed_provisions: CMDA approval for layouts > 1 acre. GCC approval for smaller plots.
FAR: Residential - 1.75 (minimum plot 120 sq.m) to 3.00.
Ground coverage: 50% to 70% based on plot area.
Setback: Front - 3m to 6m, Rear - 2m to 4m, Sides - 1.5m to 3m.
Height: Must maintain H/W ratio of 1:2 (height to road width).
Parking: 1 ECS/100 sq.m (residential), 1 ECS/50 sq.m (commercial).
Open space reservation: 10% for plots > 1000 sq.m.
Tower zone restriction: Near airport and defense areas.
Special permission needed for buildings in flood-affected zones.
penalties: CMDA violation: Demolition order. Unauthorized layout: Layout regularization fee + demolition.

law_name: Delhi Development Act, 1957 & DDA Housing Rules
summary: DDA housing scheme regulations. EWS/LIG housing mandates. Colony regularization.
detailed_provisions: DDA flats: LIG (up to ₹15 lakh), MIG (₹30-50 lakh), HIG (₹50 lakh-1 crore).
EWS housing: 15% reservation in all DDA housing projects.
Unauthorized colonies: Regularization under PM-UDAY scheme.
Colonial era buildings: Heritage protection applies in Lutyens Delhi zone.
JJ clusters: In-situ redevelopment under PMAY.
Housing for urban homeless: Night shelters mandatory for all zones.
Rent control: Delhi Rent Control Act applicable to old buildings.
Occupancy certificate: Required before habitation.
penalties: Unauthorized habitation: Eviction + demolition. DDA flat transfer violation: Flat cancellation.

law_name: Maharashtra Housing and Area Development Act, 1976
summary: MHADA housing regulations. Lottery housing, repair board, and rental housing.
detailed_provisions: MHADA lottery: Affordable housing through annual lottery system.
EWS: Up to 25 sq.m carpet area. LIG: 25-40 sq.m. MIG: 40-65 sq.m. HIG: 65-120 sq.m.
Repair board: For old buildings in Mumbai. Financial assistance for repairs.
Rent Control Act: Applies to buildings built before 1940. Standard rent applicable.
Vacant land: Must be used for purpose stated in lease. Change requires government approval.
PMRDA (Pune Metropolitan Region Development Authority) regulations apply in PMR.
Co-operative housing society formation: Mandatory for > 5 flats.
Transfer of tenancy: Restricted under Rent Control Act.
penalties: Unauthorized use of MHADA land: Eviction + prosecution. Rent Control violation: Penalty + rent fixation.

law_name: Telangana Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2017
summary: Telangana RERA implementation. Project registration and compliance for Hyderabad real estate.
detailed_provisions: Project registration: Mandatory for > 500 sq.m or > 8 apartments.
Promoter registration: ₹50,000 fee. Agent: ₹25,000.
Quarterly disclosure: Construction progress, financial status on TSRERA website.
Escrow: 70% of receipts in separate bank account.
Carpet area definition: As per NBC standards.
Defect liability period: 5 years for structural defects.
Compensation for delay: Interest at prescribed rate.
Structural engineer certification mandatory for registration.
penalties: Non-registration: 10% of project cost. False information: Imprisonment up to 1 year.

law_name: Delhi Municipal Corporation Act / State Municipal Acts
summary: Procedures and regulations for demolition of unauthorized construction. Due process requirements.
detailed_provisions: Show cause notice mandatory before demolition. Minimum 15 days response time.
Demolition order must be in writing with reasons.
Opportunity of hearing must be given to owner.
Demolition can be stayed by court. High Court and Supreme Court stay common.
Compounding (regularization) possible for minor deviations in many states.
Emergency demolition: Allowed only for imminent danger to life/property.
Cost of demolition: Recoverable from owner. Can be added to property tax.
Demolition crew: Must include structural engineer for safe demolition.
C&D waste management: Must follow C&D Waste Rules during demolition.
penalties: Forcing demolition: Imprisonment up to 1 year. Obstructing demolition: ₹50,000 fine + jail.
